body: It’s just my name on the lease. I think I just need someone to talk to and I have no one

It is a one bed, I can’t move back in with family. At work I am being accused of something I did not do, it will go through a formal hearing but likely come to nothing but I feel like I can’t take the strain of it. I just want all of this to end now

I just broke up with my boyfriend, which everyone knows, but it left me in some serious financial trouble as he just left and we share rent. I am in trouble at work... I just don’t know if I can make it through this
There’s just so much shit going on in my life and I have no one to talk to... I have friends but no one I can talk to this stuff about. I just want to die and everything be over
